author: OldManTigerMask
body:
Introduction

Hi, so I was thinking of this awesome idea to allow users to control the privacy. 
The way it works there'll be an option when you create a discussion to choose what your privacy is. Of course Sr. Mods will be able to bypass this.

Clearing stuff up
I need to clear this up first:
This is simply limiting views for example 
if you were my friend and I created a post for a Friend Only section you'll be able to see the thread & participate in it. But if you were like a random dude and are not my friend, you won't see the thread at all.

I think I needed to clear that up so people could understand what it is to make it clearer

Examples

The options would be

Global - Allows everyone to access and view the thread and participate
Friends Only - Friends can only view the thread and participate. 
Team Only - Only your team can view the thread and participate
Unlisted - Doesn't appear when you look however if someone links it in a thread or gives the link to someone they can view and comment on the thread
Private - Make the thread private to yourself (just in case you're creating a draft)

You can obviously change them whilst editing but I thought this would be a neat idea.

Please Leave Suggestions & Feedback* below, I'm more than happy to read constructive criticism without ill language.
However, I would prefer you not to quote every single thing on the page because it gets annoying :P

Thanks,
Tiger
